source: Environment Agency National LIDAR Programme / point cloud

checks.rule: Point cloud is supplied as LAZ compressed LAS
Point cloud contains discrete LIDAR returns used to create surface models
Returns are classified into ground and vegetation classes
Classification is automated and therefore not equivalent to final manually edited DTM
DSM contains ground and surface objects
DTM uses ground-classified last-return data and filters surface objects
Products are distributed in 5km OS-grid tiles
Survey-specific index catalogue metadata is available per tile
National LIDAR Programme archive period begins 2016-11-11 in current metadata
Point-cloud sample and final DTM raster sample must be treated as different evidence classes
Surface-model resolution may range from 25cm to 2m
Point cloud alone must not be promoted as official parcel height without final terrain-model gate
